references.text: Joshua's death is mentioned, marking the transition to a new generation that did not know the Lord
Moses warned that children who did not know the Lord must learn to fear him
Describes the great deeds the Lord performed through Moses for Israel, which the new generation did not know
Israel served the Lord as long as Joshua and the elders who had seen the Lord's works lived
The psalm emphasizes the importance of telling the next generation about the Lord's deeds so they do not forget
The people quickly forgot the Lord's deeds and did not wait for his counsel
